title: AI assistant
subtitle: Ask a question about your recipes, your stock or an event. The assistant suggests, you decide.

disabled.title: The assistant is not configured
disabled.text: The assistant is optional: the whole application works without it. To turn it on, add an OpenAI-compatible provider, for example Infomaniak AI Tools, in the group settings.

privacy.title: What the assistant sees and what it can do
privacy.guests: The names and notes of your guests never leave the application: the assistant only sees “guest 1”, “guest 2”.
privacy.quantities: Quantities are computed by the application, not by the assistant.
privacy.approval: Nothing changes without your approval: the assistant makes proposals that you accept or reject.

chat.title: Conversation
chat.empty: Write your question or start from an example:
chat.input-hint: Enter to send, Shift + Enter for a new line.

suggestions.stock: What can I cook with my stock?
suggestions.menu: Suggest a menu for my event
suggestions.adapt: Adapt this recipe to be gluten-free

notice.NOT_CONFIGURED: The assistant cannot answer: no AI provider is configured. The rest of the application works as usual.
notice.PROVIDER_ERROR: The AI provider did not answer or returned an error. Try again in a moment; the rest of the application works as usual.
notice.TOO_MANY_STEPS: The assistant stopped before it finished, because the request needed too many steps. Try a more specific question.
notice.EMPTY: The assistant gave no answer. Rephrase your question.
notice.REQUEST_FAILED: The request failed. Check your connection, then try again.

proposals.title: Proposals
proposals.help: Accepting a proposal applies the change in the application. A replaced ingredient stays “to verify” until you verify it yourself.

accept-hint.SHOPPING_LIST: Accepting creates the shopping plan and adds these items to your shopping list.
accept-hint.RECIPE_VARIANT: Accepting creates a new recipe; the original recipe does not change. A replaced ingredient stays “to verify” until you verify it.
accept-hint.SUBSTITUTION: Accepting creates a new recipe; the original recipe does not change. A replaced ingredient stays “to verify” until you verify it.
accept-hint.MENU: Accepting adds these dishes to the menu of the event. The dishes already on the menu stay.
accept-hint.RECIPE_DRAFT: Accepting stores this draft on the inspiration. It is not a recipe yet: you check the quantities, then you validate.

result.menu: {n} dish added to the menu. | {n} dishes added to the menu.
result.draft: The draft is stored on the inspiration.
result.unmatched: These ingredients were not found in the recipe: {ingredients}. Edit the new recipe by hand.
